usageNotes: Suspends all (or a filtered subset of) VMs and containers across the entire cluster in parallel. Use 'to-disk' (hibernate) when you need guests to survive a host reboot or power outage; omit it for a RAM-only suspend that is faster but volatile. Returns a UPID immediately — poll the task API to confirm completion before proceeding with maintenance. Caller must hold 'VM.PowerMgmt' on '/' or individually on each targeted VMID; 'to-disk' additionally requires 'VM.Config.Disk' and 'Datastore.AllocateSpace' on the state storage.

examples.summary: Hibernate a specific set of VMs to disk using shared storage, limiting concurrency to 2 workers

destructiveReason: Suspends running guests cluster-wide, interrupting all active workloads; RAM-only suspend is lost if the host reboots before guests are resumed.
tips: Omit 'vms' to target every running guest on the cluster — verify scope before calling in production.
Use 'to-disk' with a reliable shared storage (Ceph, NFS) so VMs survive unexpected node failures during maintenance.
After calling, poll the returned UPID via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status before triggering subsequent cluster operations.
